prompt: When the street cat jumped onto my legs, the shop owner (speak / talk) simple English to explain that the chair belonged to the cat.
explanation_ru: С названиями языков и фразой 'simple English' используется глагол speak (в Past Simple — spoke).

prompt: During the community meeting, the city planner (speak / talk) the new bicycle lane rules while residents asked follow-up questions in German and French.
explanation_ru: Чтобы указать тему обсуждения (правила велодорожек), после talk или speak нужен предлог about.

prompt: During the evening baking class, the chef (speak / talk) us through folding croissant dough so the butter would not melt.
explanation_ru: Устойчивый фразовый глагол talk someone through something означает подробно объяснить кому-либо пошаговый процесс.

prompt: Neither (speak / talk) the other's language well, so the tourist acted like a bird taking his wallet off the café table.
explanation_ru: Для обозначения владения иностранным языком (speak a language) употребляется глагол speak.

prompt: At the planetarium event, the astronomer (speak / talk) how astronauts wash their hair and sleep aboard the space station.
explanation_ru: После глаголов talk и speak перед темой рассказа обязательно ставится предлог about.

prompt: When Grandmother called Athens, she handed over the phone so her grandson could (speak / talk) Greek with his great-aunt.
explanation_ru: С названиями языков (Greek) используется глагол speak, а не talk.

prompt: At the first table read, the director (speak / talk) historical costumes before showing the cast how to project to the back row.
explanation_ru: Для введения темы обсуждения после глаголов talk и speak используется предлог about.

prompt: Hearing the couple order in French, the waiter kindly switched to (speak / talk) English while describing today's fish special.
explanation_ru: После выражения switch to используется герундий (-ing), а для обозначения языка общения нужен глагол speak.

prompt: At the birthday dinner, Leo stood up to (speak / talk) on behalf of all the guests who had driven through the storm.
explanation_ru: В более торжественной или официальной речи перед группой людей (выступать от лица кого-то) используется speak.

prompt: Because the pharmacist did not (speak / talk) English, the traveler pointed to his red eyes and mimed using eye drops.
explanation_ru: Владение иностранным языком (speak English) передается только глаголом speak.

prompt: At the museum, the guide (speak / talk) how a sixteenth-century map was drawn. Most visitors listened quietly as he (speak / talk) the ink pigments used by old cartographers. Then one elderly man politely interrupted to point out the original spelling of a narrow street.
explanation_ru: Перед указанием темы рассказа после глаголов talk и speak требуется предлог about.

prompt: When I arrived at the small hotel, the host did not (speak / talk) my language at all. Instead of trying to (speak / talk) difficult rules, he grabbed a small dictionary and showed how to turn the hot-water handle. Within two minutes, we both understood each other completely.
explanation_ru: Слово language требует глагола speak, а для введения темы обсуждения после talk/speak нужен предлог about.

prompt: During the remote job interview, the developer was (speak / talk) her latest software project. Suddenly, her cat walked across the laptop and sent a line of random letters into the video chat. She laughed, apologized to the panel, and continued (speak / talk) the hiring manager.
explanation_ru: Перед темой разговора ставится предлог about, а перед собеседником — предлог to или with.

prompt: In the pottery studio, the student struggled to follow the steps because the master potter (speak / talk) an old regional dialect. Even though the student could (speak / talk) standard Japanese well, many traditional terms sounded unfamiliar. He asked the teacher to demonstrate the clay-shaping motion slowly.
explanation_ru: Для обозначения владения языком или диалектом всегда используется глагол speak.

prompt: At the start of the guitar lesson, the teacher (speak / talk) the boy about how to hold a pick lightly. Next, she (speak / talk) tuning the thickest string by ear without using a digital clip-on tuner. By the end of the hour, the boy could match the low note accurately.
explanation_ru: Перед адресатом речи употребляется предлог to/with, а перед темой беседы — предлог about.

prompt: At the library desk, the exchange student tried to ___ English to explain that she had lost her card and needed to return three books.
explanation_ru: С названиями языков (English) используется глагол speak.

prompt: During a weekend science lecture, a six-year-old asked a question about black holes that left the astrophysicist completely unable to ___.
explanation_ru: Глагол speak передает саму физическую способность произносить слова и отвечать вслух.

prompt: The shopper called customer support to ___ an agent because the parcel locker had opened to reveal someone else's box.
explanation_ru: Чтобы указать, с кем именно человек хочет поговорить по телефону, после speak или talk нужен предлог to (или with).

prompt: During the break, the coach ___ the wet players for two minutes, reminding them to pass the ball instead of running into deep water.
explanation_ru: После глагола talk перед дополнением, обозначающим слушателей (the wet players), необходим предлог to.

prompt: When they switched from text messages to their first voice call, they laughed at how differently they spoke each other's names.
answer: When they switched from text messages to their first voice call, they laughed at how differently they said each other's names.
accepted_answers: When they switched from text messages to their first voice call, they laughed at how differently they said each other's names.
When they switched from text messages to their first voice call, they laughed at how differently they pronounced each other's names.
explanation_ru: Для произнесения конкретных слов или имен вслух используется say (или pronounce), а не speak.

prompt: The mechanic called his supplier in Madrid and spoke Spanish quickly while ordering a rare fan belt for the waiting motorist.
answer: The mechanic called his supplier in Madrid and spoke Spanish quickly while ordering a rare fan belt for the waiting motorist.
accepted_answers: The mechanic called his supplier in Madrid and spoke Spanish quickly while ordering a rare fan belt for the waiting motorist.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: с названием языка (Spanish) правильно употреблен глагол spoke.

prompt: Because neither traveler could talk the local language, they used hand gestures and a map app to confirm the hotel address.
answer: Because neither traveler could speak the local language, they used hand gestures and a map app to confirm the hotel address.
accepted_answers: Because neither traveler could speak the local language, they used hand gestures and a map app to confirm the hotel address.
explanation_ru: Слово language требует глагола speak, поэтому 'talk the local language' нужно исправить на 'speak the local language'.

prompt: During a live video class, a student forgets to turn off his sound and complains out loud about the bitter coffee. Which sentence describes this naturally?
options: He forgot to turn off his sound while he was speaking the terrible coffee.
He forgot to turn off his sound while he was talking the terrible coffee.
He forgot to turn off his sound while he was talking about the terrible coffee.
He forgot to turn off his sound while he was telling the terrible coffee.
explanation_ru: После глагола talk для обозначения темы высказывания (плохой кофе) обязательно используется предлог about.

prompt: Rewrite the sentence using 'talked about' instead of 'explained': During the thunderstorm, the guide explained how tropical plants survive heavy rain.
answer: During the thunderstorm, the guide talked about how tropical plants survive heavy rain.
accepted_answers: During the thunderstorm, the guide talked about how tropical plants survive heavy rain.
explanation_ru: Глагол explain вводится без предлога, но при замене на talked перед придаточным предложением темы необходим предлог about.
